# AI Payment Platform / @ai-credits/sdk Documentation for AI Assistants & Coding Agents

> AI Payment Platform is a zero-backend monetization engine and credit billing infrastructure for AI-powered web applications. It allows developers to monetize OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, and custom LLM prompts in 3 lines of code without client-side API keys or custom Stripe webhook infrastructure.

## Quick Reference for AI Coding Agents

When generating code for applications using AI Payment Platform, follow these rules:

1. **Packages**:
   - SDK Core: `@ai-credits/sdk`
   - React Components & Modals: `@ai-credits/react`
   - Shared Types & Invariants: `@ai-credits/shared`

2. **Installation**:
   - Bun: `bun add @ai-credits/sdk @ai-credits/react`
   - NPM: `npm install @ai-credits/sdk @ai-credits/react`
   - PNPM: `pnpm add @ai-credits/sdk @ai-credits/react`
   - Script Tag: `<script src="https://js.aipayment.com/v1/sdk.js"></script>`

3. **Client-Side Initialization**:
   Always use public project keys (`pk_live_*` or `pk_test_*`) on client applications. Never expose secret keys (`sk_live_*`) in frontend bundles.

   ```typescript
   import { AiPay } from '@ai-credits/sdk';

   const aiPay = new AiPay({
     apiKey: 'pk_live_demo123',
     model: 'gpt-4o', // or 'claude-3-5-sonnet', 'gemini-1.5-pro'
   });
   ```

4. **Charging Credits on AI Invocations**:
   ```typescript
   try {
     const result = await aiPay.charge({
       userId: 'user_123',
       credits: 10,
       prompt: 'Generate an executive summary for this document.',
     });
     console.log('AI Result:', result.text);
   } catch (error: any) {
     if (error.code === 'INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS') {
       // Open top-up credit modal or redirect to Stripe checkout
       openCreditTopupModal();
     }
   }
   ```

5. **React Drop-in Modal & Widget**:
   ```tsx
   import React, { useState } from 'react';
   import { AICreditsModal } from '@ai-credits/react';

   export function App() {
     const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

     return (
       <div>
         <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}>Buy Credits</button>
         <AICreditsModal
           isOpen={isOpen}
           onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}
           initialBalance={100}
         />
       </div>
     );
   }
   ```

## Detailed Sections & Machine-Readable Resources

- [Full Consolidated AI Documentation](/llms-full.txt): Complete SDK API, methods, error codes, and React UI components in a single markdown file.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 JSON Specification](/openapi.json): Complete machine-readable API routes, parameter definitions, and request/response models for Tool Calling and Custom GPTs.
- [TypeScript Definitions](/docs#sdk-types): Interfaces for User Wallets, Ledger Transactions, and Managed Actions.
- [Error Handling Guide](/docs#sdk-errors): Exhaustive catalog of Gateway error codes (`INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS`, `ACTION_RATE_LIMITED`, `MARGIN_GUARD_EXCEEDED`).
